verdict.rationale: vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server (plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC), which lets developers reuse official OpenAI Python/JS client libraries to call it, and community confirms this works well in practice. However, vLLM itself does not ship or document its own official Python/JS SDK — the story is only satisfied indirectly via third-party (OpenAI) client library compatibility. Missing for 10: a vLLM-branded official client library, explicit JS/Node usage examples, and any first-party SDK beyond API compatibility.
